URL: https://bharatkosh.gov.in The depositor/user is requested to follow the steps/Flow-chart as indicated in Annexure-I for making payme nt in Bharatkosh. SELECT FROM DROP DOWN: NFC-EMD / NFC-SECURITY DEPOSIT PAO code is 046151 and DDO code is 200901, of NFC, Hyderabad, for payments of EMD/Performance Secu rity Deposit in BHARATKOSH. The soft copy of the online payment receipt and challan generated through the system shall be uploaded a long with the bid as per the format enclosed, for enabling refund of EMD/PSD. It may be noted that in the “ REMARKS” column, the reasons for depositing the money, including Tender/Bid Reference/Contract No., Re mitter’s name, address, etc. may be mandatorily indicated as explained in Note 1 below Annexure – I, so a s to relate the payments with the activities. 5)It is to re-iterate that the Beneficiary details for submission of PSDBG shall be: The Regional Director, Purchase & Stores, Acting through/on behalf of the President of India, Government o f India, Department of Atomic Energy, 1st Floor, Hyderabad Regional Purchase Unit, Aadhaar Building, Nucl ear Fuel Complex, ECIL Post, Hyderabad, Telangana – 500 062, PMO.

Else, the PSDDD shall be in favour of Pay & Accounts Officer, NFC, payable at Hyderabad. A soft copy of the PSDBG/PSDDD shall be uploaded in the GeM portal and the original shall be submitted to this office address “A3 Section, 1st Floor, Hyderabad Regional Purchase Unit, Aadhaar Building, Nuclear Fu el Complex, ECIL Post, Hyderabad, Telangana – 500 062”, within 15 days of placement of contract. Sending the bank guarantee to the purchaser directly by the bank shall expedite the process of settlement of bills. 6)PAYMENT TERM: Supply shall be made on "as and when required basis". Hence, Payment shall be made against each lot supplied on pro rata basis. 7)Post Supply Inspection in respect of supplies made is not permitted. Any offer containing the condition of Post Supply Inspection shall be summarily rejected. It is therefore, mandatory for the bidders, while quotin g, to indicate in clear terms the requirement of Post Supply Inspection by any outside agency. Additional terms and conditions : i)The Order quantity is for 100% concentration basis, however party shall supply C.S Lye in the concentration of min 46%(W/W) in supplier’s tankers as per specification given below. Specification: Caustic soda Lye (100% )basis( Rayon grade) conforming to IS 252, The concentration of L ye Min 46%(W/W) to be supplied in suppliers tankers. ii) Supply point: Caustic soda lye is required to NFC,Hyderabad. The following is the requirement. Sr No Place of delivery/Consignee Quantity in MT 1. Stores Officer, NFC, Hyderabad 1000 iii)Delivery schedule: Supplies shall be made on “As and When required” basis. Approximate delivery schedule 85 MT (46% conc entration basis) per month. However supplies shall be completed within 15 months from placement of ord er. iv) The tender quantity will be split on more than one party in the ratio of 60:40 subject to price matching. In case none of the firms agree for price matching or single offer received, entir e quantity will be allocated to L-1 firm. v) Vendor Qualification Criteria: The offers shall be considered only from Indian manufacturers of tend ered item. A relevant document in support of the same shall be submitted along with offer. vi) Item Acceptance criteria: The analysis of control lab NFC,Hyderabad is final and binding for accepta nce of the material. . 7.
